```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```

Import NSDUH
```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"

drug_use_html = read_html(url)
```


Pull the tables out
```{r}
marj_df =
  drug_use_html |> 
  html_table() |> 
  first() |> 
  slice(-1)
```


## import star wars data
Pull in the html
```{r}
swm_html = 
  read_html_live("https://www.imdb.com/list/ls070150896/")
```

Next up... selector gadget
```{r}
swm_html |> 
  html_elements(".ipc-title-link-wrapper .ipc-title__text")

```

## Use APIs

getting a csv
```{r}
nyc_water_df =
GET("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ia2d-e54m/query.csv") |> 
  content("parsed") |> 
  select(year:per_capita_gallons_per_person_per_day)
```

get a json file
```{r}
nyc_water_json =
GET("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ia2d-e54m/query.json") 

nyc_water_json |> 
  content("text") |> 
  jsonlite::fromJSON() |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(year:per_capita_gallons_per_person_per_day)
```


Look at some pokemon
```{r}
pokemon_json = 
  GET("https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon/1")

pokemon_data =
  pokemon_json |> 
  content()

pokemon_data[["name"]]
pokemon_data[["height"]]
pokemon_data[["abilities"]]
```
